text: Rohit Sharma is Mumbai Indians captain again. Real or fake? Welcome to Paravion X. Daily world news, and whether it's real or fake. Three years ago, Mumbai took the captaincy away from him, and handed it to Hardik Pandya. Fact one. Under Hardik, Mumbai finished last in 2024, lost Qualifier 2 in 2025, and slipped to ninth in 2026. But that's not the big part. Fact two. This month, Mumbai traded Hardik to Punjab Kings, for pacer Arshdeep Singh. Eighteen crore rupees each. So, is Rohit back? Real. Mumbai Indians confirmed it on Friday. Fact three. Rohit captained Mumbai in five IPL finals, and won every single one. And the hidden message? Mumbai announced it at exactly five forty-five p.m. Fans say that's five titles, plus his jersey number, forty-five. Mumbai hasn't confirmed that. Can Rohit win Mumbai a sixth title? Yes or no? Comment below. Stay tuned for further updates, and subscribe to Paravion X for more.
